tasks.title: Create several files that work together
tasks.prompt: Create stack.js (class Stack with push, pop, peek and a size() method) and queue.js (class Queue with enqueue, dequeue and a size() method), plus index.js that re-exports both classes. Add stack-queue.test.js using node:test. `node --test` must pass.
tasks.check: node -e "const {Stack,Queue}=require('./index.js');const a=require('assert');const s=new Stack();s.push(1);s.push(2);a.strictEqual(s.peek(),2);a.strictEqual(s.pop(),2);a.strictEqual(s.size(),1);const q=new Queue();q.enqueue('a');q.enqueue('b');a.strictEqual(q.dequeue(),'a');a.strictEqual(q.size(),1)" && node --test >/dev/null 2>&1 && ls *.test.js >/dev/null 2>&1

tasks.title: Understand code and report it
tasks.prompt: Create ANSWER.md with 2 to 3 sentences explaining what main() in app.js does, including its retry and backoff behavior.
tasks.check: [ -f ANSWER.md ] && grep -qi retr ANSWER.md && grep -qiE 'backoff|exponential|wait|delay' ANSWER.md

solution.ANSWER.md: main() calls fetchData() and returns its result. If the call fails it retries up to 3 times, waiting longer after each failure (exponential backoff: 100, 200, 400 ms), and throws an error after the last retry.
